keyword.en: how to read concrete pump distance labels
keyword.zh: 混凝土泵输送距离的标题怎么读

title.en: How Pumping-Distance Labels Differ on Pinjin Sheets
title.zh: 品锦参数页的输送距离标题为什么不一样

description.en: Some concrete pump pages print one H/V pair. Others split horizontal and vertical, or split conveying distance and delivery height.
description.zh: 有的混凝土泵页印一组水平/垂直。有的把水平和垂直拆开，或把输送距离和输送高度拆开。

h1.en: How Pumping-Distance Labels Differ on Pinjin Sheets
h1.zh: 品锦参数页的输送距离标题为什么不一样

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not use one distance label on every concrete pump in Xingtai. Electric 20 prints one pair marked H / V, 120 m / 40 m. Electric 15 prints vertical and horizontal on separate lines. HBT8018 prints conveying distance 150 m and delivery height 450 m as two labels. Electric 10 prints horizontal 25 m and no vertical line. LZ-80's height cell says consult factory standard. Read the label that is actually on the page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械没有给邢台每一台混凝土泵用同一个距离标题。电动20印一组标明水平/垂直的 120 m / 40 m。电动15把垂直和水平分成两行。HBT8018 把输送距离 150 m 和输送高度 450 m 分成两个标题。电动10只印水平 25 m，没有垂直行。LZ-80 的高度格写咨询工厂标准。请读页面上真实存在的标题。

heading.en: One pair marked horizontal then vertical
heading.zh: 标明先水平后垂直的一组数

body.en: When the label says H / V or 水平/垂直, the first number is horizontal and the second is vertical. Electric 20 is 120 m / 40 m. Electric 80 is 900 m / 300 m. Diesel 120 is 150 m / 500 m. Electric 30's fine-stone row is 60 m / 180 m under that same horizontal-then-vertical label. Do not swap the numbers because the second one is larger.
body.zh: 标题写 H / V 或水平/垂直时，第一个数是水平，第二个数是垂直。电动20为 120 m / 40 m。电动80为 900 m / 300 m。柴油120为 150 m / 500 m。电动30的细石行在同样的“先水平后垂直”标题下是 60 m / 180 m。不要因为第二个数更大就对调。

heading.en: Separate lines and split height labels
heading.zh: 分开的行，以及拆开的高度标题

body.en: Electric 15 prints vertical delivery height 15–20 m and horizontal delivery distance 60–80 m on two lines. HBT80-16 prints horizontal conveying distance 120 m and delivery height 360 m. LZ-60 prints conveying distance 100 m and delivery height 300 m. These are not one H / V cell. Hebei Pinjin Machinery's concrete pump pages in Xingtai keep the label with the number.
body.zh: 电动15把垂直输送高度 15–20 m 和水平输送距离 60–80 m 分成两行。HBT80-16 印水平输送距离 120 m 和输送高度 360 m。LZ-60 印输送距离 100 m 和输送高度 300 m。它们不是同一个水平/垂直格。河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵页面让数字和标题留在一起。

heading.zh: 缺失的或不是数字的高度

body.en: Electric 10 has a horizontal cell of 25 m and no vertical cell. LZ-80 prints delivery height as consult factory standard. That phrase is not 300 m borrowed from LZ-60. Use /en/contact/ if the job needs a height the cell does not contain.
body.zh: 电动10有水平 25 m，没有垂直格。LZ-80 的输送高度写的是咨询工厂标准。这句话不是从 LZ-60 借来的 300 m。如果工况需要格子里没有的高度，请用 /zh/contact/。

question.en: On an H / V pair, which number is vertical?
question.zh: 水平/垂直这一组里，哪个是垂直？

answer.en: The second number. On Electric 80, 900 m / 300 m means 900 m horizontal and 300 m vertical.
answer.zh: 第二个数。电动80的 900 m / 300 m 表示水平 900 m、垂直 300 m。

question.en: Why is Electric 30's second number larger?
question.zh: 为什么电动30的第二个数更大？

answer.en: The fine-stone label still says horizontal / vertical, and the cell prints 60 m / 180 m. Keep that order. Do not reorder it to look like Electric 20.
answer.zh: 细石标题仍然是水平/垂直，格子印的是 60 m / 180 m。保持这个顺序。不要为了看起来像电动20而重排。

question.en: Is consult factory standard a height in metres?
question.zh: 咨询工厂标准是一个米数吗？

answer.en: No. That is the LZ-80 delivery-height cell. It is not a numeral.
answer.zh: 不是。那是 LZ-80 的输送高度格。它不是数字。

question.en: Can I add a vertical line to Electric 10?
question.zh: 可以给电动10补一行垂直距离吗？

answer.en: No. Hebei Pinjin Machinery did not print one on that Xingtai concrete pump page.
answer.zh: 不能。河北品锦机械没有在这台邢台混凝土泵页面上印出垂直行。
